subject: general
question:
Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

The Prime Minister is making no (rash) promises.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Considerate**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence means that the Prime Minister is not making any impulsive or hasty promises.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• **The given word 'rash' means impulsive or hasty.**(जल्दबाज)
 
 
• ​Example: Making rash decisions is very bad.
 
 
 
• **The opposite of 'rash' is 'considerate', which means careful and thoughtful.**(विचारशील)
 
 
• ​Example: You need to be considerate of others before making any decisions.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word 'considerate' is the correct answer as it is opposite in meaning to 'rash'.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Immature) means not fully developed or grown, and is not opposite in meaning to 'rash'.(अविकसित)
 
• Option 3 (Audacious) means bold or daring, which is similar to one of the other options given in the question, but not opposite in meaning to 'rash'.(साहसी)
 
• Option 4 (Bold) is similar in meaning to 'audacious' and is not opposite in meaning to 'rash'.(निर्भीक)
